sources.quality_notes: Official K4-84 call; 133 juan/45 books, MF35-1905~11, extant woodblock imitation of Eulhae type with indeterminate impression date. Extant copy must not be dated to 1478 initial movable-type edition. Original images section lists book038 and MF-PDF001–045; nearby official PDF links _032 38,652,924 bytes, _033 39,469,189, _034 46,467,304 but web endpoint rejects oversized body; exact v94 book/page and original glyph NOT inspected. Different custody from Kyoto RB00028368; independence of actual text or plate NOT proved. Access policy free private scholarly view, publication reuse restrictions. Not a G893 numeric ancestor vote.
